title: sports.game
description: Box-score detail for one game: the game header (teams, score, status, series) plus the home/away team-stat comparison and a few headlines. event_id is an ESPN event id taken from a sports.scores game (the game's `id` field). An unknown event id returns MeshDeny: sports_game_not_found. Cached ~60s.

league.description: League id (case-insensitive). Must match the league the event belongs to, e.g. 'nba'.

event_id.description: ESPN event id for the game, as returned in a sports.scores game's `id` field.
